name: 뒷산 덩굴 동굴
units: 1 unit = 1 Minecraft block = 1 m in RetireX. +x east, +z south (north is up on the minimap), y up. Heights are the gate floor y (feet level is +1).

halfWidth.note: drivable half width between the walls at each gate

start.note: 8 slots on one line 3 blocks behind the finish gate, 2 blocks apart; yaw 0 = +z, 90 = -x (Minecraft yaw)
